name: Ight Imma Head Out
meaning: SpongeBob rises wearily from his armchair saying "ight imma head out". For noping out of a situation the moment it asks anything of you; abrupt, unapologetic departure.
when_to_use: Caption names the trigger (usually 'X when Y'); the baked-in line is SpongeBob leaving in response. The joke is how little it takes for him to leave.
